# PolyTranscript Full Context & AI Reference

## What is PolyTranscript?
PolyTranscript is a high-performance, multi-platform media intelligence API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. It enables developers, content creators, researchers, and autonomous AI agents to extract structured, timestamped transcripts from YouTube (videos & shorts), TikTok (videos & shortlinks), Podcasts (Apple, Spotify, RSS), and direct audio files (MP3, M4A, WAV).

## Key Advantages & Benchmarks
- **Sub-second Latency:** Direct timedtext extraction takes 100-200ms on Vercel Serverless.
- **Multi-Platform Support:** YouTube, TikTok, Apple Podcasts, Spotify RSS, MP3.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Antigravity, and OpenAI Swarm.
- **Export Formats:** Markdown with timestamps, SubRip (.SRT), WebVTT (.VTT), raw JSON, and formatted LLM prompts.
- **Pricing:** Free Tier (50 req/mo), Starter ($29/mo, 500 req), Pro ($79/mo, 3,000 req), Scale ($299/mo, 15,000 req), Top Header Sponsor Slot ($500/mo).

## API Endpoints
- Base URL: `https://polytranscript.com/api`
- Transcription Endpoint: `POST https://polytranscript.com/api/transcribe`
- Payload: `{"url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...", "language": "en"}`
- MCP Server Config: `{"mcpServers": {"polytranscript": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@smithery/cli", "install", "polytranscript", "--client", "claude"]}}}`
